name: Blueprint
inspiration: Owain's notes on the house look (October 2026), with the structure of herk-edit-kit's style library and the flat techniques of its Kallaway style: focus-pull entrances, word-anchored staggers, drawn connectors, odometer counts. No glow, glass or gradients.
summary: Cool paper and graphite with a quiet blueprint grid, white cards, cool ink and one clean blue. Split-first: graphics in the top half, the speaker on the bottom half. Calm, minimal, real content.

fonts.notes: Helvetica for structure, one Signifier italic word per line, mono for labels and numbers.

motion: Expo-out entrances out of a light blur, staggered about 0.12 s. Things not yet said sit dim and soft, then sharpen on their word. One camera move per shot.

cards.summary: A chapter marker: a large number lands out of a blur, its name tracked out below.
The thesis in one line, word by word, with a rule drawing under it. One *accent* word.
One big number that counts up, a rule, and what it counts. Only a real, sourced number.
